meta.name: _Generic Downlight Spotlight - Matt White
meta.description: This is a generic matt white round recessed downlight, a single fixture. The housing is a short cylinder, probably about 8.9 cm wide and 3.1 cm deep, set into a ceiling cut-out with no yoke, arms, or pan and tilt. Its upper side carries finned black heat-sink ribs on the left and a small black rectangular driver box on the right, while thin spring clips sit on the lower-left rim. The front is a flat glass disc with a white bezel ring. Roughly four LED chips form a tight central cluster with no regular grid. It has one controllable cell, so the chips probably switch together as a single intensity group, and colour mixing is probably not modelled.
